sentimento.text1: The presidential book has accumulated USD 138.28M and the price on this page is from the confirmed reading of Aug 28, 3:31 PM BRT (6:31 PM UTC). The day brought no national poll: the most recent is still PoderData/Aya of Aug 27. The fact of the day is one of calendar, not of polling, and it is the debut of free campaign advertising on radio and television, with four candidates holding airtime.
sentimento.text2: On price, the leader stood STILL at 57.50% and the runner-up gave up 1.20pp, to 35.65%, the largest move on the panel in the outright-winner contract. With that, the distance between the two went from 20.65pp to 21.85pp. It is the second time in two days that the gap moves entirely from one side: yesterday it narrowed on the runner-up's rise, today it widened on his fall, both times with the leader motionless.
sentimento.text3: Outside the outright-winner contract, the day has two changes of position. Augusto Cury gave up 0.55pp on winning, to 3.50%, and at the same time ROSE 2.95pp in the third-place contract, to 26.70%. Renan Santos did the opposite on winning, rising 0.55pp to 2.90%, and gave up 0.50pp on third place, to 35.50%. Ronaldo Caiado rose 1.00pp on third place, to 34.50%, and there the three sit within 8.80pp of one another.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 35.65% (vol USD 9.13M) in the presidential book, down 1.20pp, the largest move on the panel today. In the second-place contract for the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) he ROSE 0.50pp, to 85.00%, so his two books moved in OPPOSITE directions on the same day. He was interviewed on Jornal Nacional on Friday, a day after his opponent, and the rival's campaign advertising debuted using an audio recording of him with Daniel Vorcaro. At a dinner with some 20 bankers and business leaders, the lack of more robust proposals drew distrust, according to O Globo.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 57.50% (vol USD 9.34M), UNCHANGED on the day after giving up 5.00pp the day before. At the debut of campaign advertising, his campaign tied the opponent to a kickback scheme, to former banker Daniel Vorcaro and to a group of contract killers, according to Folha de S.Paulo, and used the audio in which the rival calls Vorcaro brother. Quaest released a state-by-state series this week showing him in a [technical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) with the opponent in the country's three largest electorates, São Paulo, Minas Gerais and Rio de Janeiro, according to G1.
sentimento.terceiraVia: Augusto Cury gave up 0.55pp in the outright-winner contract, to 3.50% (vol USD 2.36M), on the second day of that contract's life, and on the same day rose 2.95pp on third place, to 26.70%. Renan Santos at 2.90% (vol USD 11.73M), up 0.55pp, two days after touching the floor of his entire series. Ronaldo Caiado at 0.25% (vol USD 6.88M) on winning, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading, and at 34.50% in the third-place contract, where he rose 1.00pp. His first television spot airs on Saturday, according to VEJA.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the confirmed reading of Aug 28, 3:31 PM BRT (6:31 PM UTC). AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, taken eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, and the confirmation is done contract by contract. Names below 0.5% stay outside that watch, because a thin book swings on its own. The presidential book has accumulated USD 138.28M since it opened.

inss.text1: The case saw no new investigative act on Friday, and what there was instead was a dispute over WHO investigates. The president, whose son is under investigation, told the head of the Federal Police to make peace with the reporting justice at the Supreme Court, according to Estadão. The rift between Flávio Dino and André Mendonça became the axis of coverage: the two appear as the main antagonists in the Lulinha and Dark Horse cases, according to Folha de S.Paulo.
inss.text2: On the campaign reading, a relevant caveat came from inside the polling industry itself. The founder of one institute told the BBC that the economy, and not the Lulinha case, is what should decide the election. And the BBC itself records that the case puts the president's campaign under pressure, detailing what the [PF](/en/glossary#pf) is investigating about his son.
inss.text3: On the other side, the opponent's relief is not automatic. According to Folha de S.Paulo, the opposition candidate gets relief from the Lulinha case, but undecided voters keep demanding an explanation from him about his own episode, the audio recording with the former [Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) banker. The two cases run in parallel and neither was resolved on Friday.
inss.text4: ⚠️ The case remains live and unresolved. The distinction the panel has kept from the start still holds: the effect on how the government is rated is one thing, the effect on voting intention is another, and the two do not move together by default. There was no national poll released today to measure either.
inss.impactoLula: Not isolable, and today THERE IS NO NEW READING to measure it. The cleanest comparison is still PoderData against itself: 38% in the first round on Aug 27 against 41% on Aug 13, same method and same sample. On price, his outright-winner contract stood still at 57.50% on Friday, after giving up 5.00pp the day before.
inss.impactoGestao: No new reading on Friday. The week's four measurements are still the latest available: 42% approval against 50% disapproval in PoderData of Aug 27, 46% against 50% in Indexa/Broadcast of Aug 26, 43% against 51% in Gerp of Aug 26, and 48% against 49% in BTG/Nexus of Aug 24. All four with a negative balance, and the most recent one carries the widest.
inss.conclusao: On Aug 28 the case does not advance as an investigation and does advance as a dispute over jurisdiction. The panel records both movements and does not convert one into the other: who investigates is an institutional question, and by itself it says nothing about what voters will do in October.

bancoMaster.text1: The testimony was set for Friday morning, by video link, after two postponements. G1 reported at 5:27 PM that the Federal Police had CONCLUDED the hearing of Daniel Vorcaro in the inquiry examining his relationship with two Central Bank officials. The panel records the information with its source, because as of this reading it is the only one published after the act.
bancoMaster.text2: The case gained a front outside the country on Friday. The United States justice system asked for detailed information from One World Services, the crypto-asset trading platform to which Banco Master sent USD 531 million, about R$ 2.8 billion, according to Estadão. It is the first time the investigation appears with a formal request from a foreign authority.
bancoMaster.text3: And a development appeared about who does the reporting. An asset manager who says he is under threat because of his Master disclosures asked the Supreme Court for protection after a court barred him from writing about the former head of the securities regulator, according to VEJA. The subject of the main inquiry has not changed: how former Central Bank supervision directors acted on behalf of the bank while it faced a liquidity crisis.
bancoMaster.conclusao: ⭐ AND HERE IS THE CROSSING OF THE DAY. The case stopped being only an investigation and became a campaign item at the debut of campaign advertising: the leader's spot used the audio in which the runner-up calls Vorcaro brother, according to Revista Fórum and Folha de S.Paulo. On the same day, the runner-up's price gave up 1.20pp, the largest move on the panel. The panel records both on the same date and does NOT claim one caused the other: one day of advertising does not isolate an effect, and the same candidate's second-place book rose 0.50pp.

stf.toffoli: No new individual act captured on Aug 28. He extended the inquiry into Banco Master the day before.
stf.moraes: No new individual act captured on Aug 28.
stf.gilmar: No new individual act captured on Aug 28.
stf.dino: He said the judiciary's over-prominence is not desirable, but that the Supreme Court cannot stand aside, according to Folha de S.Paulo. He appears, alongside Mendonça, as one of the two poles of the rift over who investigates the Lulinha and Dark Horse cases.
stf.mendonca: ⭐ HE IS THE NAME OF THE DAY AT THE COURT FOR THE THIRD DAY RUNNING. He summoned X to explain to the electoral court, within 24 hours, the filter that blocks the recommendation of candidate profiles, according to O Globo. And he remains locked in the standoff with the Federal Police leadership over the inquiry into the president's son, a standoff the president himself asked to be calmed, according to Estadão.
stf.nexo: ⭐ THE THREAD OF THE DAY IS STILL ONE OF JURISDICTION, AND NOW IT HAS A NAME: A RIFT. Folha de S.Paulo describes Dino and Mendonça as the main antagonists in the campaign's two biggest cases. The dispute is not about the merits of either inquiry: it is about who conducts them and where. Add the summons to X over its algorithm, and on Friday the court appears regulating all three terrains at once, investigation, jurisdiction and advertising.
stf.analise: The contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 sits at 3.40% (vol USD 84,000), unchanged in the confirmed reading of Aug 28, 3:31 PM BRT (6:31 PM UTC). It has been at 3.40% on 13 of the last 14 days, with a single reading of 3.50% on Aug 26. ⚠️ It is the smallest book on the panel, and in a book that size half a percentage point does not separate news from noise: the level tells you more than the move.
